messages:
maya: heads-up — production is spiking 503s for org=acme-corp, we're seeing burst-budget-depleted despite low token usage earlier. :rotating_light:
alex: logs? any recent deploys or quota changes?
sre-oncall: oncall looking. I see lots of 429->503 cascades from the routing layer. Here's a snippet: ```BurstManager: org=acme-corp burst_budget=-1200 reconcile=double_apply detected=true worker_id=cb-7```
liz: deploy-bot shows a canary rollback at 16:04 but around 16:02 there was a console rollback operation by ops.team — maybe overlap?
ops: @liz yes I tried to rollback the burst-budget rollback after the canary flaked. I used the console UI and hit Apply, it showed success.
sebastian: weird, console-bot shows two audit events within 10s for same org: ```audit: user=ops action=quota_update target=org:acme-corp delta=-600``` and then again ```audit: user=ops action=quota_update target=key:rk_abc123 delta=-600``` — looks like it applied to both org and key.
maya: that would double-debit the effective available budget. So a UI bug where the modal defaulted both scopes to apply.
alex: temporary mitigation: can we force a positive burst top-up for the org while we fix the UI? curl to admin API: ```curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/internal/quotas/topup" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"org_id":"acme-corp","amount":2000,"scope":"org"}'```
sre-oncall: done — pushed +2000 to org burst budget at 16:10. Service error rate dropped quickly to normal.
deploy-bot: canary rollback completed at 16:05 (rollout-id r-2026-03-18-736).
sebastian: root cause hypothesis: console rollback flow accidentally issues two separate updates when both "Apply to org" and "Apply to key" toggles are true. For some customers with token-level routing, that double-debits the same logical budget.
liz: we'll patch the console so toggles are mutually exclusive and add guardrails server-side to idempotently coalesce same-target updates.
ops: also need an alert rule that detects negative burst budget or large delta within a short window — current alert only looks at bucket depletion but not double-apply patterns.
maya: agree. Followups: 1) hotfix console toggle + server idempotency (sebastian/liz) 2) add reconciliation job fix to ignore duplicate updates (alex) 3) retro + customer comms (ops/maya).
sebastian: opening PR for server idempotency and a unit test for concurrent quota updates. ETA 12h.
liz: console patch pushed to staging, QA now. UX change: make toggles radio buttons and put a confirmation when delta > 500 tokens.
ops: reaching out to acme-corp support contact to explain incident and offer monthly credit. Drafting message.
console-bot: audit-summary: 2 quota-updates applied for org=acme-corp at 1769801187 by ops; reconciler later observed negative balance and auto-topup applied.
maya: thanks everyone. Logging follow-up meeting at 17:30 to review SLA impact and customer message. :white_check_mark:
